groups.calibration_data: same 100 OpenThoughts3 training prompts; initial teacher and Base responses
groups.layer_label: 14th of 28 decoder blocks; zero-based index 13, verify actual Base config
groups.direction: mean of initial Base pooled teacher-response activations minus initial Base pooled own-response activations
groups.pooling: equal weight per question; exclude structural/special tokens; within each pair use equal counts, at most 512 uniformly spaced content states; both representations from the same frozen Base

calibration_generation.student_prompt_protocol: verified Base native prompt/template; archive actual prompt tokens
calibration_generation.filter: report incomplete/degenerate pairs and usable count; never select using AIME accuracy

groups.alpha: rho * median_calibration_activation_norm / direction_norm; freeze after extraction
groups.loss_integration: Use original-fork candidate-ID surrogate as the reference; explicitly audit hook adaptation and distribution semantics. No silent replacement with pilot teacher-top-K forward KL or cross-tokenizer candidate KL.
groups.schedule_status: throughout the proposed OPD pilot; no intermediate cutoff
groups.injection_positions: At the selected block, all valid response-token prediction states t-1 (includes final prompt state for the first answer token); exclude padding and invalid positions.
groups.hook_forward_scope: loss forward and matching backward recomputation only; ordinary rollout, teacher/reference scoring and evaluation forwards are unhooked

data.interpretation: AIME2025 is evaluation-only; OPD uses a 100-question subset of the original OpenThoughts3 OPD source.
data.sft_original: 200K OpenThoughts3 math teacher responses; author released checkpoint available
data.opd_selection: After deduplication, AIME2025 overlap checks and original prompt-length eligibility, sample 100 eligible questions without replacement. Freeze IDs and preserve source text.
data.sft_initialization: Deferred by user; no SFT checkpoint or SFT training corpus required for this pilot.
data.calibration: Proposed: use the same 100 OPD prompt IDs for offline T/S0 generation and direction extraction; no AIME2025 questions; offline texts never replace live OPD rollouts.

original_training.policy_loss: original fork PPO top-K surrogate; must audit numerical and gradient equivalence before launch
original_training.original_gpu_setup: 8 x A800 80GB; any local execution changes must be recorded

evaluation.accuracy: avg@16; mean correctness across per-question samples, not pass@16
evaluation.overlap: sum of Top16 intersection counts / (16 * valid response prediction positions), on ordinary student prefixes, no hook
evaluation.overlap_source_original: training rollout metrics, not the standalone accuracy generator
evaluation.rendering: Two panels over proposed pilot steps 0–50: AIME2025 avg@16 and no-hook Overlap@16. Current two-group pilot compares ordinary OPD and scheme_1 with full-training loss-forward steering. Scheme_2 remains in the main plan; its first-panel inclusion is not frozen.

proposed_pilot.stream: Repeat the frozen ordered 100-prompt pool cyclically to exactly 3200 prompt visits; same IDs/order across all groups. Avoid drop_last silently excluding the last 36 prompts. Generate fresh trajectories each step.
proposed_pilot.overlap: No-hook training rollout overlap every step, pre-update; label by the exact model state used. Record an initial value and endpoint on fresh ordinary rollouts; no steered overlap substituted.
proposed_pilot.further_extension: Do not automatically extend to 200 steps; review the pilot first.
proposed_pilot.limitation: Small repeated-prompt pilot. Compare the added value of steering over matched Base OPD only; it does not establish equivalence or superiority to SFT. Paper SFT results are contextual references from a different training setup.
proposed_pilot.intervention_schedule: throughout all 50 trainer steps; rollout and evaluation are unhooked

deviations_from_original: 100 unique OpenThoughts3 OPD prompts instead of approximately 30K
Repeat the same 100 prompts for 50 trainer steps (32 effective passes), instead of original one-pass data coverage; 0–50 display window
AIME2025 only instead of all three Figure 8 accuracy benchmarks
Offline checkpoint evaluation every 10 steps for pilot resolution instead of official save_freq20
Steering layer/strength/early duration are project additions; implementation adaptation must be labeled
Local device topology/runtime may differ and must be recorded; preserve global batch and mathematical baseline

research_framing.question: Can either of two student-space directions help OPD learn from teacher supervision, reducing or avoiding a separate cold-start SFT stage?
research_framing.ordinary_student_evaluation: The main method steers all valid response prediction positions during loss forwards throughout OPD; all rollout, diagnostic and evaluation forwards remain ordinary.
research_framing.early_definition: If tested, early means the first H OPD trainer steps. H=10 was a project pilot proposal, not a schedule prescribed by either cited paper.
research_framing.schedule_status: Main setting: all 50 proposed pilot trainer steps. Early-only H-step injection is a follow-up schedule ablation.

literature.mechanism: Fixed student GT/teacher-response minus own-response direction during teacher-forced supervised/distillation training; evaluation without direction. No general first-10-step cutoff specified.

Frozen correct-minus-wrong direction scores rollouts; modify advantages on verifier-wrong rollouts, including all-wrong zero-variance GRPO groups. This is SV-Rescue, rather than direct activation injection for a first-H-step warmup.
Separate teacher-response SFT cold start before ordinary OPD.
Teacher-aligned prompt templates/content during OPD, rather than a fixed early-only intervention.

research_framing.hypothesis_boundary: Common motivation is improving usable training signals or compatibility. These sources neither prove that OPD failures are GRPO zero-variance failures nor establish that increasing overlap guarantees accuracy gains.
research_framing.replacement_claim: Reducing or replacing separate cold-start SFT is a hypothesis. The current no-SFT-control pilot can establish added value over matched ordinary OPD only.

direction_schemes.injection: same protocol as scheme_1; changing direction does not change its timing or mask
direction_schemes.pilot_status: retained in full research plan; inclusion in the first 100-question panel is not yet frozen
direction_schemes.additional_comparison: Under matched triplet pooling and weights, offset=R-S0 and total_triplet=cap+offset; pure capability/style separation is unproven.

injection_policy.active_baseline: fixed all valid response prediction positions; g_t=1
injection_policy.direction_axis: scheme_1 versus scheme_2 defines v; it is independent of injection gating

candidate_gate.status: discussion only; not implemented or scheduled
candidate_gate.entropy_role: auxiliary diagnostic first; entropy gap alone does not identify agreement or steer benefit
candidate_gate.metric_policy: Unhooked, same student-visible prefix, current update-before-training student/teacher distributions; freeze across forward/backward recomputation
candidate_gate.loss_mask: unchanged; gating selects injection positions rather than dropping OPD supervision
controls: random-position gate with matched coverage, direction, layer and strength
candidate_gate.selection: training/independent dev only; no AIME threshold tuning
candidate_gate.cost: Reuse cached unhooked top-K where available; account for added scoring or forward passes. Sparse vector addition does not by itself eliminate teacher/student model compute.
candidate_gate.evidence_boundary: Low overlap or a large entropy gap is not proof that steering is needed; compare shared mass and no-hook learning gains.
